title: Bangladesh Machine Readable Passport (MRP) — New Application Requirements
content:
To apply for a new Bangladesh Machine Readable Passport (MRP), the following documents are required:

1. Completed Online Application Form (obtainable from the Department of Immigration and Passports portal)
2. National Identity Card (NID) — original and photocopy; or Birth Registration Certificate for applicants under 20 years
3. Previous passport (if applicable) — original and photocopies of cover and last entry pages
4. Proof of citizenship (for dual nationals as applicable)
5. Two recent passport-size photographs (as per specifications)
6. Bank payment receipt showing the applicable fee payment

Fees (as per DIP schedule):
- Regular (21 working days): BDT 3,000 for 48-page passport, BDT 5,000 for 64-page passport
- Emergency (7 working days): BDT 6,000 for 48-page passport, BDT 8,000 for 64-page passport
- Super Emergency (2 working days): BDT 8,000 for 48-page passport, BDT 12,000 for 64-page passport

Applications are submitted at the nearest Passport Office or Regional Passport Office. The applicant must appear in person for biometric enrollment (fingerprint and photograph).
authority: Department of Immigration and Passports (DIP), Ministry of Home Affairs

title: Bangladesh Passport Renewal (MRP) — Required Documents
content:
For renewal of an existing Machine Readable Passport (MRP), the applicant must provide:

1. Existing valid or expired passport — original
2. Online application form (submitted through DIP portal)
3. National Identity Card (NID) — original and photocopy
4. Bank payment receipt for the applicable renewal fee
5. Police clearance (if residing abroad)

The renewal process follows the same fee schedule as new applications:
- Regular: BDT 3,000 (48-page) or BDT 5,000 (64-page)
- Emergency: BDT 6,000 (48-page) or BDT 8,000 (64-page)

For renewals, biometric data may be re-captured if the existing records are more than 10 years old or if the applicant's appearance has changed significantly.

Online application link: https://www.epassport.gov.bd
authority: Department of Immigration and Passports (DIP), Ministry of Home Affairs

title: Bangladesh e-Passport — New Application Process
content:
Bangladesh introduced the electronic passport (e-Passport) from 2020. The e-Passport contains a biometric chip with the holder's photograph and fingerprints.

To apply for an e-Passport:
1. Register online at https://www.epassport.gov.bd
2. Fill the online application form
3. Choose appointment date and office
4. Pay the applicable fee via bank or mobile payment
5. Appear at the designated passport office on appointment date for biometric capture
6. Collect the completed passport or opt for home delivery

Required documents at the office:
- National Identity Card (NID) — original
- Birth Certificate (for applicants under 20)
- Previous passport (if available)
- Bank/mobile payment confirmation

Fee schedule (e-Passport, 5-year validity):
- 21 working days: BDT 3,000 (48-page), BDT 5,000 (64-page)
- 7 working days: BDT 6,000 (48-page), BDT 8,000 (64-page)
- 2 working days: BDT 8,000 (48-page), BDT 12,000 (64-page)

Fee schedule (e-Passport, 10-year validity):
- 21 working days: BDT 5,000 (48-page), BDT 7,000 (64-page)
- 7 working days: BDT 8,000 (48-page), BDT 10,000 (64-page)
- 2 working days: BDT 10,000 (48-page), BDT 13,000 (64-page)
authority: Department of Immigration and Passports (DIP), Ministry of Home Affairs

title: পাসপোর্ট আবেদনের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় কাগজপত্র — বাংলা
content:
নতুন পাসপোর্টের জন্য আবেদনে নিম্নলিখিত কাগজপত্র প্রয়োজন:

১. অনলাইন আবেদন ফর্ম (www.epassport.gov.bd থেকে পূরণ করতে হবে)
২. জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র (NID) — মূল এবং ফটোকপি
৩. জন্মনিবন্ধন সনদ (২০ বছরের নিচে আবেদনকারীর ক্ষেত্রে)
৪. পূর্ববর্তী পাসপোর্ট থাকলে — মূল এবং প্রথম ও শেষ পাতার ফটোকপি
৫. নির্ধারিত ব্যাংকে ফি পরিশোধের রসিদ
৬. সাম্প্রতিক পাসপোর্ট সাইজের ছবি

পাসপোর্ট ফি:
- সাধারণ (২১ কার্যদিবস): ৪৮ পাতা — ৩,০০০ টাকা; ৬৪ পাতা — ৫,০০০ টাকা
- জরুরি (৭ কার্যদিবস): ৪৮ পাতা — ৬,০০০ টাকা; ৬৪ পাতা — ৮,০০০ টাকা
- অতি জরুরি (২ কার্যদিবস): ৪৮ পাতা — ৮,০০০ টাকা; ৬৪ পাতা — ১২,০০০ টাকা

আবেদনকারীকে বায়োমেট্রিক (আঙুলের ছাপ ও ছবি) প্রদানের জন্য নিকটস্থ পাসপোর্ট অফিসে সশরীরে উপস্থিত হতে হবে।
authority: ইমিগ্রেশন ও পাসপোর্ট অধিদপ্তর, স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়

title: National ID Card (NID) — Correction of Information
content:
Citizens who need to correct information on their National Identity Card (NID) can apply through the Bangladesh Election Commission's online portal.

Steps to apply for NID correction:
1. Visit the NID service portal: https://services.nidw.gov.bd
2. Register or log in using your NID number and date of birth
3. Select 'Correction/Update' from the services menu
4. Submit the correction form with supporting documents
5. Pay the applicable correction fee
6. Track your application status online

Required documents for name correction:
- Original NID card
- Birth registration certificate (original)
- SSC/HSC certificate (where applicable)
- Sworn affidavit (in some cases)

Required documents for date of birth correction:
- Original NID card
- Birth registration certificate
- SSC/HSC certificate
- Medical certificate (if applicable)

Required documents for address correction:
- Original NID card
- Utility bill (electricity/gas/water) showing new address
- Holding tax receipt (optional but helpful)

Correction fee: BDT 230 (as per current schedule — verify with EC before applying).

Processing time: Generally 15–30 working days. Complex corrections may take longer.

title: জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র সংশোধনের প্রক্রিয়া — বাংলা
content:
জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্রে তথ্য সংশোধনের জন্য নিম্নলিখিত পদ্ধতিতে আবেদন করতে হবে:

১. NID সেবা পোর্টাল (https://services.nidw.gov.bd) -এ প্রবেশ করুন
২. NID নম্বর ও জন্মতারিখ দিয়ে লগইন করুন
৩. 'তথ্য সংশোধন' বিকল্পটি নির্বাচন করুন
৪. সংশোধন ফর্ম পূরণ করুন এবং প্রয়োজনীয় কাগজপত্র আপলোড করুন
৫. নির্ধারিত ফি পরিশোধ করুন

নাম সংশোধনের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় কাগজপত্র:
- মূল NID কার্ড
- জন্ম নিবন্ধন সনদ
- এসএসসি বা সমমানের সনদপত্র
- হলফনামা (প্রয়োজনে)

জন্ম তারিখ সংশোধনের জন্য:
- মূল NID কার্ড
- জন্ম নিবন্ধন সনদ
- এসএসসি সনদ
- চিকিৎসা সনদ (প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে)

ঠিকানা সংশোধনের জন্য:
- মূল NID কার্ড
- বিদ্যুৎ/গ্যাস/পানির বিল (নতুন ঠিকানা সংবলিত)
- হোল্ডিং ট্যাক্সের রসিদ

সংশোধন ফি: ২৩০ টাকা (আবেদনের আগে নির্বাচন কমিশন থেকে বর্তমান ফি যাচাই করুন)।

প্রক্রিয়াকরণের সময়: সাধারণত ১৫–৩০ কার্যদিবস।
authority: বাংলাদেশ নির্বাচন কমিশন — জাতীয় পরিচয় নিবন্ধন অনুবিভাগ

title: Smart NID Card — Application for New Voters
content:
Citizens who have turned 18 and wish to register as voters and obtain an NID card must:

1. Check voter registration status at https://services.nidw.gov.bd
2. If not registered, visit the local Union Parishad / City Corporation / Pourashava office during voter registration drive
3. Provide biometric data (photograph and fingerprints) at the registration office
4. Submit required documents:
   - Birth Registration Certificate
   - Educational certificate (SSC/JSC or equivalent)
   - Father's/Mother's NID (for identity verification)
5. Receive NID Slip (temporary ID) immediately
6. Smart NID card is delivered to the address within 30-90 days

Note: New voter registration drives are announced periodically by the Bangladesh Election Commission. Check the EC website for current registration periods.

title: TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) — Online Registration
content:
A Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) or e-TIN is required for filing income tax returns, obtaining trade licenses, opening bank accounts above certain limits, and various other business and government activities.

How to register for e-TIN online:
1. Visit the National Board of Revenue (NBR) e-TIN portal: https://secure.incometax.gov.bd/TINHome
2. Click 'Register' and provide your NID number or passport number
3. Fill in personal information: name, address, source of income
4. Select your tax circle and zone
5. Submit the form
6. Receive your 12-digit TIN certificate immediately (printable from the portal)

Required information:
- National Identity Card (NID) number (preferred)
- OR valid passport number (for non-NID holders)
- Mobile number (for OTP verification)
- Permanent address
- Source of income description

e-TIN registration is FREE. No fee is charged for initial registration.

Who must obtain TIN:
- Individuals with taxable income
- Company owners and business proprietors
- Anyone buying/selling land above a certain threshold
- Professionals (doctors, lawyers, engineers, etc.) for membership/license
- Import/export license applicants
authority: National Board of Revenue (NBR), Internal Resources Division, Ministry of Finance

title: ই-টিন নিবন্ধন প্রক্রিয়া — বাংলা
content:
ই-টিন (করদাতা শনাক্তকারী নম্বর) নিবন্ধনের পদ্ধতি:

১. জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের পোর্টালে যান: https://secure.incometax.gov.bd/TINHome
২. 'নিবন্ধন' বোতামে ক্লিক করুন
৩. আপনার NID নম্বর বা পাসপোর্ট নম্বর প্রদান করুন
৪. ব্যক্তিগত তথ্য পূরণ করুন: নাম, ঠিকানা, আয়ের উৎস
৫. কর সার্কেল ও অঞ্চল নির্বাচন করুন
৬. ফর্ম জমা দিন
৭. ১২ সংখ্যার টিআইএন সনদ তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে পোর্টাল থেকে প্রিন্ট করুন

প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য:
- জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র (NID) নম্বর
- অথবা পাসপোর্ট নম্বর (NID না থাকলে)
- মোবাইল নম্বর (OTP যাচাইয়ের জন্য)
- স্থায়ী ঠিকানা
- আয়ের উৎস বিবরণ

ই-টিন নিবন্ধন বিনামূল্যে। কোনো ফি প্রযোজ্য নয়।

যাদের টিআইএন থাকা বাধ্যতামূলক:
- করযোগ্য আয় আছে এমন ব্যক্তি
- ব্যবসায়ী ও কোম্পানির মালিক
- নির্দিষ্ট সীমার উপরে জমি ক্রয়-বিক্রয়
- পেশাদার ব্যক্তি (চিকিৎসক, আইনজীবী, প্রকৌশলী)
- আমদানি-রপ্তানি লাইসেন্সধারী
authority: জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড (NBR), অভ্যন্তরীণ সম্পদ বিভাগ, অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়

title: Income Tax Return Filing — Bangladesh (e-Return)
content:
Individual taxpayers in Bangladesh can file income tax returns online through the NBR e-Return portal.

Steps to file e-Return:
1. Visit https://etaxnbr.gov.bd
2. Log in using your TIN and password
3. Select tax year (July–June)
4. Complete the appropriate return form (IT-11GA for individuals)
5. Attach supporting documents (salary certificates, bank statements, etc.)
6. Calculate tax liability and pay online if applicable
7. Submit return and download acknowledgement slip

The deadline for individual income tax return is typically 30 November each year. Verify the exact deadline with NBR as it may be extended.

Tax-free income threshold (FY 2023-24):
- General taxpayers: BDT 3,50,000 per year
- Women and taxpayers over 65: BDT 4,00,000 per year
- Persons with disability: BDT 4,75,000 per year
- Freedom fighters: BDT 5,00,000 per year

Note: Tax rates and thresholds change annually. Always verify the current rates from the National Budget or NBR circular for the relevant tax year.
authority: National Board of Revenue (NBR), Internal Resources Division, Ministry of Finance

title: Passport Application — Minor (Under 18)
content:
For applicants under 18 years of age, the following additional requirements apply:

1. Birth registration certificate — original and photocopy
2. Parent/guardian's NID card — original and photocopy
3. Parent/guardian's passport (if available)
4. School/institution certificate or enrollment proof
5. Completed application form signed by parent/guardian
6. Consent letter from parent/guardian (if only one parent accompanies)

For children under 6: Parent must appear with the child for biometric capture. A simplified biometric process (fewer fingerprints) may apply.

Minor passports: Typically issued with 5-year validity. The child must appear in person for biometric enrollment.

Note: Both parents' consent may be required in certain circumstances (e.g., sole custody, divorce). Verify with the Passport Office for specific family situations.
authority: Department of Immigration and Passports (DIP), Ministry of Home Affairs

title: NID Card Loss — Replacement Application
content:
If your NID card is lost or damaged, you can apply for a replacement:

1. File a General Diary (GD) with the nearest police station for the lost card
2. Obtain the GD copy
3. Log in to https://services.nidw.gov.bd
4. Select 'Replacement' from services
5. Upload the GD copy and complete the application form
6. Pay the replacement fee
7. Smart NID will be reissued

Replacement fee: BDT 345 (first replacement) — verify current fee with EC before applying.

For damaged cards: Submit the damaged card along with the application. A GD may not be required for damaged (rather than lost) cards.

Smart NID delivery: Replacement cards are typically delivered to the registered address within 30–60 working days after processing.

title: Passport FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions
content:
Q: How long does it take to get a passport in Bangladesh?
A: Under the regular process: 21 working days. Emergency: 7 working days. Super Emergency: 2 working days. These are targets; actual processing may vary.

Q: Can I apply for a passport without an NID?
A: Citizens under 20 years may use a Birth Registration Certificate in lieu of an NID. Others must present an NID.

Q: Where can I pay the passport fee?
A: Fees are paid at designated bank branches (Sonali Bank, Premier Bank, or others as notified by DIP). Verify the accepted bank list from the DIP portal before visiting.

Q: Can I track my passport application?
A: Yes, application status can be tracked at https://www.epassport.gov.bd using your application ID.

Q: Is biometric enrollment mandatory?
A: Yes, all applicants must appear in person at the Passport Office for biometric capture (photograph + fingerprints).

Q: What is the validity period of a Bangladesh passport?
A: Standard passports are issued for 5 or 10 years. Choose at the time of application. Fees differ based on validity period.
authority: Department of Immigration and Passports (DIP), Ministry of Home Affairs

title: NID FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions
content:
Q: How do I check if I am registered as a voter?
A: Visit https://services.nidw.gov.bd and enter your NID number or check via the national voter list.

Q: Can I update my NID photo?
A: Photo update requires visiting the NID Wing office in person with supporting documents. Online photo update is not currently available.

Q: I got married — do I need to update my NID?
A: You may update your marital status and, if your name changed, submit a name correction request with the marriage certificate.

Q: How many times can I correct my NID information?
A: Each correction type has its own fee. Multiple corrections may require additional documentation and approval.

Q: Can someone else collect my NID on my behalf?
A: For Smart NID cards delivered by post, collection by a third party is generally not required. For office pickup, authorized representative with written consent and their own NID may be possible — verify with the EC office.

Q: My NID has wrong information I never submitted — what do I do?
A: Apply for correction with supporting documents proving the correct information. Errors introduced by the system do not usually require additional fees.

title: TIN/e-TIN FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions
content:
Q: Is TIN registration free?
A: Yes, e-TIN registration through the NBR portal is free of charge.

Q: Can I cancel my TIN?
A: TIN cancellation requires applying to your tax circle with a letter stating the reason. Conditions apply (e.g., no outstanding tax liability).

Q: I lost my TIN certificate — how do I get a new one?
A: Log in to https://secure.incometax.gov.bd and download/print your TIN certificate again at any time. The certificate is always available online.

Q: Does having a TIN mean I have to pay tax?
A: Not necessarily. TIN registration is separate from tax liability. If your income is below the tax-free threshold, you may not owe any tax, but you may still need to file a nil return if required.

Q: What is the current income tax rate in Bangladesh?
A: Tax rates are set annually in the national budget. Verify the current slab rates from the NBR website or the latest Finance Act.

Q: I need TIN for my trade license — is it the same TIN?
A: Yes, the 12-digit e-TIN is used for all official purposes including trade license applications, bank accounts, and income tax returns.
authority: National Board of Revenue (NBR), Internal Resources Division, Ministry of Finance
